question: A person with high blood pressure should take which of the following foods?

options.text: Whole grains, fruits, vegetables and low-fat dairy products

solution:
The answer is __**Whole grains, fruits, vegetables, and low-fat dairy products. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Blood pressure is a lifestyle disease in which the** force of the blood against the artery walls is too high,** It leads to even heart-related problems.<
